dialogues.speaker: Slumbering Monster
dialogues.text: This creature seems to be related to the Electro Hypostasis you encountered before in Mondstadt, but it does not react at all as you approach. Perhaps it is in a deep slumber.

dialogues.speaker: Slumbering Monster
dialogues.text: You know not what caused it to appear here, nor do you know when it will awaken... It may be safest to keep your distance for now.
